Name: U-1.6 Port Minor Light Tweaks and Auto Fireplaces
Author: ZumiiNongki
Description:
[b][size=5]# Minor Light Tweaks - Unofficial 1.6 Port[/size][/b]

This is an unofficial update and port of the [b]Minor Light Tweaks[/b] mod (originally created by [b][i]greentodd[/i][/b]) for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+.

[b][size=4]🌟 Features Included in this Release[/size][/b]
[b][i]  Auto Fireplaces: [/i][/b]Automatically turns fireplaces on/off based on the time of day and season.
 [i][b]SMAPI 4.0+ & Stardew Valley 1.6 Compatibility:[/b][/i] Fully updated C# code to work smoothly with the latest game standards without console errors.

---

[b][size=4]🛠️ Requirements[/size][/b]
 Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
 SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer

---

[b][size=4]📦 Installation[/size][/b]
1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI (https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod and extract the `.zip` file.
3. Drop the extracted `MinorLightTweaks16Port` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Run the game using `StardewModdingAPI.exe`.

---
